name: Casa do deserto · Interior
prompt: Precise single-object size correction. Preserve this entire furnished overhead house and every wall, doorway, window, floor tile, hearth, rug, table and decoration exactly. Change ONLY the central DOUBLE BED and the floor pixels uncovered by its smaller footprint. A double bed must measure 1.60m wide and 2.10m long in this 9-square-wide VTT building. Relative to the OUTER perimeter wall rectangle's total width, the bed frame INCLUDING its posts must be EXACTLY about 14.6% wide and 19.2% long. The current bed is too long and slightly too wide: reduce its width to 85% of its present width and its length to 75% of its present length, retaining its center and orientation on the rug. Keep TWO side-by-side pillows and a true double mattress. The clear floor around its reduced outline must match the existing floor and rug. All other objects unchanged. Strict orthographic 90-degree overhead. No labels, grid, dimensions, people or token. Transparent outside walls.
